acnh.intro: Ketchup is a peppy duck villager in the. After her debut in, she would remain absent from the series until. Her name comes from, a condiment made from tomatoes, which references her tomato-like appearance. Her favorite saying also refers to her appearance.
acnh.appearance: Ketchup is a tomato-red duck — orange beak and cheeks, black legs, and green leaf-like hair above a yellow belly with lime-green wing tips. Every line of her design reads picnic-sweet, from seasonings to stem, name and silhouette aligned like a farm-stand label.
acnh.personality: Ketchup sparkles with peppy cheer, easy friendship, and bursts of emotion over small things that fade as quickly as they flare. Snooty and cranky barbs sting; she may feel insulted when fashion or gossip turns sharp. Lazy neighbors can feel awkward in conversation, while jocks, smug villagers, big sister types, and fellow peppy neighbors keep her bouncing with shared energy. Short memory for slights, long memory for kindness — she settles quickly into the villagers she trusts and rewards them with gifts and compliments.

villagerInfo.quote: When in doubt, eat a tomato!
